title: Identification and functional characterization of a SUZ12 frameshift variant in a Chinese family with Imagawa-Matsumoto syndrome.
authors: Xu, Xin; Xu, Hong; Huang, Songming; He, Yikang; Zhang, Ling
one_liner_zh: 该文通过全外显子测序和AlphaFold 3预测SUZ12移码变异对PRC2复合物结构的影响，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作相关表观调控，但核心为临床遗传学与蛋白表达验证，缺乏TF-DNA结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法深度。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Imagawa-Matsumoto syndrome (IMMAS) is a rare overgrowth disorder caused by heterozygous loss-of-function variants in SUZ12, which encodes a core subunit of the Polycomb Repressive Complex 2 (PRC2). To date, fewer than 20 cases have been reported, and the molecular mechanisms underlying PRC2 dysfunction in IMMAS remain incompletely understood. METHODS: Trio-based whole-exome sequencing (Trio-WES) was performed in a Chinese family presenting with overgrowth and dysmorphic features. The candidate variant was validated by Sanger sequencing and segregation analysis. AlphaFold 3 was used to predict the structural consequences of the variant. In vitro overexpression and protein assays were conducted to evaluate SUZ12 protein expression and subcellular localization. RESULTS: The proband exhibited global developmental delay, macrocephaly, hypertrichosis, and distinctive craniofacial dysmorphism. Trio-WES identified a heterozygous frameshift variant in SUZ12 (c.1244_1248del; p.Glu415GlyfsTer5). Computational modeling predicted that the truncating variant removes the ZnF and VEFS domains and may affect the predicted SUZ12-EZH2 interface. In vitro expression of the mutant construct confirmed the production of a truncated SUZ12 protein. Furthermore, peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) from both the proband and her mother showed a substantial global reduction in H3K27me3 levels, consistent with impaired PRC2-mediated histone methylation in vivo. CONCLUSIONS: We report a Chinese family with Imagawa-Matsumoto syndrome harboring a SUZ12 frameshift variant (c.1244_1248del; p.Glu415GlyfsTer5). Our study expands the phenotypic spectrum associated with this variant and provides evidence consistent with impaired PRC2-mediated histone methylation.
abstract_zh: 背景：Imagawa-Msumoto综合征（IMMAS）是一种罕见的过度生长障碍，由SUZ12基因的杂合功能丧失型变异引起，该基因编码多梳抑制复合物2（PRC2）的核心亚基。迄今为止，已报道的病例不足20例，且IMMAS中PRC2功能障碍的分子机制仍未完全阐明。方法：在一个表现为过度生长和畸形特征的中国家系中进行了基于三人组的全外显子组测序（Trio-WES）。候选变异通过Sanger测序和分离分析进行验证。使用AlphaFold 3预测该变异的结构后果。通过体外过表达和蛋白质检测评估SUZ12蛋白表达及亚细胞定位。结果：先证者表现出全面发育迟缓、巨头畸形、多毛症和特征性颅面畸形。Trio-WES鉴定出SUZ12基因中的一个杂合移码变异（c.1244_1248del；p.Glu415GlyfsTer5）。计算模型预测该截短变异会移除ZnF和VEFS结构域，并可能影响预测的SUZ12-EZH2界面。突变构建体的体外表达确认产生了截短的SUZ12蛋白。此外，先证者及其母亲的外周血单核细胞（PBMCs）均显示H3K27me3水平显著整体降低，与体内PRC2介导的组蛋白甲基化受损一致。结论：我们报告了一个携带SUZ12移码变异（c.1244_1248del；p.Glu415GlyfsTer5）的Imagawa-Matsumoto综合征中国家系。我们的研究扩展了与该变异相关的表型谱，并提供了与PRC2介导的组蛋白甲基化受损一致的证据。
